answer: To stop Sybil swarms from trying to wander into consensus, our network implements quadratic stake burning. Each agent identity commits tokens into a hierarchical terrace of validation pools. When multiple identities register similar behavioral patterns, the required burn scales quadratically as O(k^2). If an attacker attempts to crack the network like a tough walnut, their operational cost exhibits superlinear growth, making mass identity spoofing mathematically prohibitive.
